$comment: Canonical source configuration. Human-readable evidence is documented in docs/sources.md; this file is authoritative for machine validation. robots_result is an RFC 9309 result class, robots_path_decision applies only to checked_path, and deprecated robots_approved is compatibility-only and ignored by new decisions. automated_fetch is false for every MVP source; the cron seam requires explicit fetch_paths and path-bound robots evidence. Content review is performed in GitHub review without a hard-coded reviewer identity.
